title: General and conservative dentistry
description: Prevention first, then targeted care. Cleanings, selective endodontics, restorations, and follow-up with durable materials and realistic timelines. Operative care with judgment.

items.name: Comprehensive checkup
items.description: Full oral exam, x-rays as needed, gum health assessment, and a written summary of findings with recommendations.

items.name: Professional cleaning (prophylaxis)
items.description: Plaque and tartar removal, polishing, fluoride application, and home-care guidance tailored to your situation.

items.name: Composite restoration (filling)
items.description: High-grade German composite, layered for natural appearance and durability. Single-surface and multi-surface options.

items.name: Root canal treatment (single canal)
items.description: Endodontic treatment for infected or damaged teeth, performed with magnification and modern techniques.

Treatment plan with options and costs
Follow-up to ensure stability and comfort
